notes.title: hot fix save game and +
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
I'm going to release a new patch for backups and more ...
I will proceed as follows:

1) I opted for automatic backups in order to fix some 'bugs'.
You can no longer save at any time,
(don't panic) there are now two important automatic save points.
The first at the start of the outdoor areas (first part of the game)
The second in the entrance hall of the boarding school (second part of the game)
(This does not affect the game experience but mainly fixes the 'bugs' previously encountered)

2) I fixed display problems after the kinematics of the basement.

3) I have set a 'widget' which sometimes persist on the screen.

4) let us know if there is anything going on that seems abnormal to you.

(well, I think today to get a final version of DOUDY but if you have 'bugs' in your home, let me know)

A big thank you again for your support, it is very encouraging for the future!
GOOD DOUDY TO EVERYONE.

I will keep you informed when the path will be there!

notes.title: HOT FIX MAJOR
notes.notes:
Hello everyone ! 
Today I would like to thank you for your multiple downloads of DOUDY,
However, as some of you have noticed, the gaming experience was not necessarily the one that should have been for launching the game via STEAM.
I'm alone and this is my first game on steam,
BUT ! After receiving your support and your gaming experiences on the different PCs I was able to make, refine, improve the games as they should be.
of his release!
I apologize for the inconvenience caused by your gaming experience and would like to thank you for being so many of you supporting DOUDY.
The launching problems could be solved and the games and functional as it should be, we proceeded as follows:

HOT FIX Major:

1) Optimization of exteriors / FrameRate etc.

2) removal of the SETTING button in the quick menu of the games to correct the 'widget' of the main menu in 'parent'

3) You can now click on TAB or I to go to the inventory without going through the quick menu of the games.

4) Major experience for the game, THE PADLOCK (one of the main enigma) has been corrected, you must now click on the left mouse button (basic interaction key)
to interact correctly with and thus enter the correct code (which considerably lengthens the life of the game) to gain access to the second part.

5) Addition of light on the fuel canister to see it correctly.

6) texture modified on 'interactable' furniture.

7) Optimization of the main menu and saving of corrected options.

8) Correction of small bugs of collisions and others.

Thank you again for your support and good DOUDY to all!
